No line of IX.107–223 is a set piece in the conventions table. Two much-quoted lines were built from the Latin with no borrowed wording (post-review `i`): IX.185 (*an sua cuique deus fit dira cupido?*), "or does each man's own dread craving grow into a god for him?", and IX.182 (*His amor unus erat*), "The two had one love between them".
